sources.title: ByteDance backend interview note containing the exact array predicate prompt
Deterministic prefix-min/suffix-max validation against independent quadratic oracle

claims.text: The source asks to print array values that are smaller than all preceding elements and larger than all following elements; it does not define endpoint behavior when one side is empty.
For internal positions, the all-elements predicate is equivalent to value < minimum(left prefix) and value > maximum(right suffix), enabling an O(n) scan after suffix preprocessing.
The implementation uses strict comparisons, explicitly excludes endpoints, and matches an independent O(n^2) oracle on six fixed cases plus 5000 deterministic randomized arrays.
